description:
Fixes #2600

I personally encounter the problem when using broot and ZLE functions in Zsh, where micro detects it's not a standard terminal IO situation, yet a real file is being edited. In this case I want to be able to save the file being edited, and I don't want the file content dumped to stdout.

comments.body: Ah, thank you! I had totally missed that while the initial check was for stdout, this lower check was for stdin -- I thought they were both stdout checks. Yes, please take it away with any changes you deem appropriate, as long "option 1" (with file args) keeps using the default buffer.

Ok, but how to proceed...will you update your PR?
Please remember to split logical and cosmetic changes into separate commits.

I can update in a bunch of hours or tomorrow, but if someone beats me to it that's great, too. Do you mean that moving the initial buffer type assignment further down (to be closer to its reassignment) is a cosmetic change, which should happen in an isolated commit?
Alright, please have another look. Thanks!
Sure, I've made the change. Thanks!
Sure, I've replaced the streamlined logic with the more explicit distinction. Thanks!

We can now remove
```go
var input []byte
var err error
```
from line 162+163 too and replace `input, err = io.ReadAll(os.Stdin)` in line 238 with `input, err := io.ReadAll(os.Stdin)`

The commit message doesn't fit any longer.
I assume the change history needs a bit more polish now.

@dmaluka:
What do you think? In case we squash them it is not really a problem, but it might become one in case we keep them separate.
I can do this in a bit. But are you sure you're looking at the current state? The commit messages seem to match their commits to me. The original second commit is completely absent.
I can do this in a bit. But are you sure you're looking at the current state? The commit messages seem to match their commits to me. The original second commit is completely absent.

> But are you sure you're looking at the current state?

Your second commit https://github.com/zyedidia/micro/pull/3910/commits/4debd29ccf7d195bb86a81977a76de74bb400a94 is named "Make the buffer creation when (no file args, terminal stdin) explicitly distinct

...but functionally equivalent.", but only changes this:

```diff
-			buffers = append(buffers, buffer.NewBufferFromStringWithCommand(string(input), filename, btype, command))
+			buffers = append(buffers, buffer.NewBufferFromStringWithCommand("", filename, btype, command))
```

Doesn't really fit any longer. :wink:

That's not an old message attached to an updated change, that message was written specifically for that exact change. If it's inaccurate, I don't understand why, and maybe I misunderstood [this suggestion](https://github.com/zyedidia/micro/pull/3910#discussion_r2575140941).

> We can now remove
> 
> ```go
> var input []byte
> var err error
> ```

I've added a new commit for this.
I see no problem with that commit message either.

OK, so be it.
Just one more small thing:
`var filename string` is totally useless too and can be replaced by two distinct `""`.
Afterwards it is ready2go.
I was curious about that! I'll add the change now.
